finding: Print review exposed the old exclusive food/job model in WAGOLL. Follow-through checked the active reveal script, information cards and supported exit. All are corrected together.

changes.before: A body needs different types of food because each type does a different job. Bread gives energy but it cannot do the repairing.
changes.after: A body needs a range of foods. Bread gives energy and some protein. Foods give us a mix of nutrients. One food can help with more than one body job.

changes.before:
Circle the job bread does: energy / repair

energy
changes.after:
Circle one food that gives energy: bread / water

bread

changes.before: No single food does every job. That is why variety matters.
changes.after: Foods give us different amounts of nutrients. That is why variety matters.
Starchy carbohydrate gives us energy. Bread also gives us some protein, vitamins and minerals.

changes.before: Which of the three jobs does it do?
changes.after: Name one job this food helps with. It may help with more than one.

changes.before: Bread. Rice. Pasta. These are the energy ones.
changes.after: Bread. Rice. Pasta. These give us energy and other nutrients.

changes.before: Eggs. Beans. Fish. These are the building ones.
changes.after: Eggs. Beans. Fish. Their protein helps us grow and repair. They give us other nutrients too.

changes.before: Now — is there ONE food that can do all three on its own? Have a think.
changes.after: Can one food help with more than one job? Have a think.

changes.before: No single food does all three jobs. That is why we eat different types.
changes.after: One food can help with more than one job. Foods give us different amounts of nutrients.

changes.before: No. Nothing here does all three. That is why we eat different types.
changes.after: Yes. These columns show examples, not each food’s only job. A range of foods gives us a mix of nutrients.

changes.before: Right column. The tick means right JOB — not good food or bad food.
changes.after: This is one job bread helps with. Its protein helps with growth and repair too.

changes.before: Right column. Tick means right JOB. Nothing else.
changes.after: This is one job these foods help with. Beans give us energy too.

changes.before: Right column. Tick means right JOB.
changes.after: This is one job these foods help with. Their nutrients help in a range of ways.

changes.before: Three jobs. No single food does all three.
changes.after: Three jobs. One food may help with more than one. These are examples.

sourceMeaning: Starchy foods provide energy plus a range of other nutrients. Food groups are not exclusive body-job bins.
